description:
QTL and GWAS results for legumes: soybean (SoyBase QTL on genetic maps plus GWAS; marker positions on Wm82.a2 = Ensembl glycine_max), common bean (G19833 v1 = Ensembl phaseolus_vulgaris; some GWAS on G19833 v2), cowpea (IT97K-499-35 v1) and peanut (Tifrunner v2) from LIS; faba bean QTL markers from 56 studies (Faba Bean Genome Consortium compilation, positions on Hedin/2 v2 and projected to the Ensembl Hedin/2 v1 assembly); lentil protein and amino acid GWAS on the diversity panel (KnowPulse, CDC Redberry v2 = LIS lentil genes); chickpea, lentil, pea, faba bean, lupin, grass pea and pigeonpea QTL and GWAS from pulsedb.org (Cool Season Food Legume Database). Search by trait words (e.g.
'seed oil', 'pod dehiscence', 'chocolate spot', 'lysine'; soybean traits use SoyBase names such as 'SCN', 'SDS',
'Sclero', so check legume_qtl_traits) and/or a physical region (species + chromosome as in the
marker assembly or the Ensembl name, start, end). Returns each QTL (genetic map, linkage group, cM interval,
markers) or marker-trait association (marker, p-value where reported) with study, DOI and marker positions;
ensembl_region gives genes_in_region arguments where the markers are on the Ensembl assembly (faba bean: positions
projected from Hedin/2 v2 to v1 through gene matches, approximate), lis_region gives legume_genes_in_region
arguments (lentil).
name: legume_qtl
